narratives.Overview: Ghostreader is a CLI-based AI literary analysis tool that functions as an intelligent, agentic beta reader and editorial ghost. It reads fiction manuscripts (chapters or full novels) and delivers high-quality, structured feedback on literary craft including prose quality, repetitive writing habits, narrative strengths/weaknesses, character arcs, pacing, and overall literary effectiveness.
narratives.TechStack: CLI using Python 3.12+ — Typer (CLI framework), Rich (terminal UI), LangGraph + LangChain (agent orchestration with openai/anthropic/ollama backends), LanceDB (local vector store for manuscript retrieval), pydantic + PyYAML (config), ebooklib + markdown (input format handling)
narratives.Quality: Run task check before every commit. Achieve >= 85% coverage overall + per-module. Store secrets in secrets/ dir.
